structured.answer: Open an account at Pesagot and buy "ילין לפידות מחקה S&P 500 (4D)", which the page marks as "הזול" (cheapest); it says I'd have 86,492 ₪ after 10 years. That's for its example of 10,000 now plus 500 a month, not my 30,000, so I'd still need to put my own amount in.
